title: Focus Group on Artificial Intelligence for Health
reasoning: The paper discusses the importance of trustworthiness, clarifying responsibilities, and ensuring safe and appropriate use of AI in healthcare, which are related to ethical deployment. It also mentions 'policy, regulatory, cultural, business and other practical aspects' and 'guidance documents for national administrations will support the safe and appropriate use of AI in healthcare'. However, it does not propose evaluating or benchmarking AI on religion, morals, or ethics as a primary subject of assessment, nor does it treat these as core components of its benchmarking framework.
